description:
Get Google Finance Quote

Fetches one Google Finance quote by ticker (`q` as Google Finance writes it: `GOOGL:NASDAQ` for stocks and ETFs, `.INX:INDEXSP` for indexes, `VFIAX:MUTF` for mutual funds, `GCW00:COMEX` for futures, `EUR-USD` for currencies, `BTC-USD` for crypto). Returns `summary` (name, ticker, exchange, asset type, price as displayed and as a number, currency, previous close, price movement, quote time, and the pre-market/after-hours quote when Google shows one), `graph` price points with ISO dates and volume for the `window` time range (1D, 5D, 1M, 6M, YTD, 1Y, 5Y, MAX), `knowledgeGraph` key stats and company profile, `newsResults`, `financials` (income statement, balance sheet and cash flow for the last 8 quarters and every reported year, with year-over-year change), `discoverMore` related tickers, and `markets` index, currency, crypto and futures overviews. Every ticker carries a `hasdataLink` to fetch it with this API. An unknown ticker returns `suggestions` of matching tickers instead. Use it for price monitoring, portfolio dashboards, fundamentals research and market datasets.

hl.description: The two-letter language code for the language you want to use for the search. Provide one exact documented value (159 allowed), e.g. `af`, `ak`.

q.description: Ticker as Google Finance writes it, e.g. `GOOGL:NASDAQ`, `.INX:INDEXSP`, `EUR-USD` or `BTC-USD`. An unknown ticker returns `suggestions`.

window.description: Time range of the price chart in `graph`.
